name: zhuangxiu-demand
description: 装修需求发现助手：领域包（字段规格 / 规则 / 摘要 / 数据）+ Taro 呈现层（小程序与 Web）

scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:app && pnpm run test:preview && pnpm run test:demo && pnpm run test:designer
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:domain && pnpm run typecheck:app
scripts.build:h5: pnpm --dir app exec taro build --type h5
scripts.build:weapp: pnpm --dir app exec taro build --type weapp
scripts.dev:h5: pnpm --dir app exec taro build --type h5 --watch
